turns.customer: Order #1039 hasn't even arrived yet but I already know I don't want those sandals. Can I send them back once they get here?
turns.reply: Yes, you can return the Riverwalk Camp Sandal once it arrives, as long as it is unused and in its original packaging. Returns can be started once the order has been delivered, within 30 days of delivery. At that point, you can generate a return label from your account to send the item back, and the warehouse will issue a refund to your original payment method once they receive it, usually within 5 business days.
